WITH original AS (
 SELECT count(*) source_rows,
 coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN json_type(TRY_CAST("related_bills_json" AS JSON))='ARRAY' THEN json_array_length(TRY_CAST("related_bills_json" AS JSON)) ELSE 0 END),0) expected_occurrences
 FROM "congress_bills"),
 dispositions AS (SELECT parsing_status, count(*) n FROM "bill_related_bills_occurrences" GROUP BY parsing_status),
 statuses AS (SELECT field_state,count(*) n FROM "bill_related_bills_field_states" GROUP BY field_state)
 SELECT original.*,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "bill_related_bills_occurrences") actual_occurrences,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "bill_related_bills_occurrences" WHERE parsing_status <> 'valid') invalid_occurrences,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "bill_related_bills_occurrences" WHERE target_status='unsupported') unrouted_occurrences,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "bill_related_bills_pairs") distinct_source_target_pairs,
 (SELECT to_json(list(struct_pack(status:=parsing_status,n:=n))) FROM dispositions) disposition_counts_json,
 (SELECT to_json(list(struct_pack(status:=field_state,n:=n))) FROM statuses) field_state_counts_json
 FROM original
